main_text.p: piis proveniunt nobis impo- sterum falsa multa, involut- quam plurima, quia Princi- piis commentitiis contortis- que proveniunt. Sed ecce aliud quiddam in commodum studiosæ juventutis meditatus est Magister Noster: rem hercule compendio facilem! Tene hæc pauca, tyruncule, & te deinceps, te, inquam, Naturæ consultior erit nemo: Intelligentias, formas substantiales, Causam primam, Influentias & Qualitates occultas, Vapores & exhalationes: Percepistin' hæc puncta? Euge! his expedies omnia: Intelligentias quidem non applicabis, nisi ad res magni momenti

page.notes: Right edge shows show-through and part of the adjoining page, not transcribed. Hyphenated line ends kept as printed. Text partly obscured at column edges, but readable. Catchword "pii" is faint and doubtful.
